questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content:
The strength of an aqueous NaOH solution is most accurately determined by titrating :
(Note : consider that an appropriate indicator is used)

options.content: Aq. NaOH in a pipette and aqueous oxalic acid in a burette
Aq. NaOH in a burette and aqueous oxalic acid in a conical flask
Aq. NaOH in a volumetric flask and concentrated H<sub>2</sub>SO<sub>4</sub> in a conical flask
Aq. NaOH in a burette and concentrated H<sub>2</sub>SO<sub>4</sub> in a conical flask

questions.explanation: Aq. NaOH in a burette and aqueous oxalic acid in a conical flask.
